parsed.explanation: The operative regime criminalises consensual same-sex conduct (10 years' hard labour), with the statute functioning as a documented police lever against gender-nonconforming people: harassment of trans women, failure to investigate anti-LGBT murder (the 2013 mob killing of a gender-nonconforming 16-year-old, unsolved for nearly a decade), and vigilante and custodial violence with documented impunity. Custody by birth sex is the de facto rule with no gender-recognition framework; documented harms include corrective rape, isolation and lockup beatings. Society is pervasively hostile (85-88% disapproval), venues refuse LGBT groups, and police openly decline protection. No universal border/facility exposure is documented, but the state-tolerated-targeting tier plus thin recourse, mitigated only by insulated resort areas, yields a High Risk score.

entry_documents.protection: No documented trans-specific border friction; one entry bar involved a foreign anti-gay pastor, not a trans visitor.
entry_documents.interaction: No LGR framework exists to inform any accommodation decision, so any custody or institutional encounter defaults to birth sex.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Severe, documented: perceived-LGBT prisoners isolated, rehabilitation non-existent, prisoner violence common and LGBTQI+-targeted in triply overcrowded facilities; January 2023 lockup beating with scalding liquid; wardens implicated in inmate violence; corrective rape prevalent.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: None documented; few seek recourse through the prison system.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: A sodomy arrest or any charge routes a trans visitor directly into birth-sex custody with documented identity-targeted violence.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: Police harassment of trans women documented; police stated they could not protect LGBT people during 2019 venue blockades; crime reporting deterred by police leaks and non-investigation.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: State failure to investigate or protect converts societal hostility into effective impunity.

care_services.exposure: Documented harassment of gay and lesbian patients by hospital staff; 2023 UN survey documents trans service exclusion in health care (resident-facing).
care_services.interaction: A visitor needing emergency care could encounter the same staff harassment documented for residents; short stays reduce but do not remove this.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Buggery statute (10 years' hard labour) actively used as a lever against gender-nonconforming people; no SO/GI discrimination statute; constitutional bar on union recognition; officials' hostility paired with police impunity.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Tourism director's 2019 welcome statement; entry bar applied to an anti-gay pastor.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Criminalisation plus documented enforcement against gender-nonconforming people amplifies all other axes.

minors_guardians.exposure: A 16-year-old gender-nonconforming minor was mob-killed in 2013 with no investigation; a gay student was beaten on campus. Minor travellers are not specially addressed.
minors_guardians.interaction: Travelling with a minor multiplies exposure to public hostility and police indifference documented toward young LGBT people.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: Patterned violence: 2012 counts (53 assaults, 2+ killings, 68 sexual-abuse reports), vigilante beating, cutting, burning, rape, shooting of outed people; mob killing of a trans-attributable teenager unsolved; majority of LGBTQ people reported facing homophobic violence; media lyrics inciting attacks.
street_violence_police_response.protection: Police fail to investigate, leak details, and sometimes refuse protection; impunity documented.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Tourist resort areas are insulated bubbles where incidents are rare — a genuine but narrow mitigation for visitors staying within them.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Regional human-rights petitions pending; court access for LGBT media claims failed; no effective domestic remedy documented for violence or discrimination.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Constitutional court system exists; regional commission is a partial external avenue.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Recourse is documented as failing; entry screening, passport markers and device searches are unresolved open questions, not exposures.

anchor_checks.comparison: Comparable extortion-and-impunity pattern, but the dossier here adds heavier lethal violence (mob killing of a minor, killings celebrated by crowds), documented police torture allegations, and pervasive societal hostility — worse than 0.25-B.

Similar birth-sex custody with assault exposure and a criminalisation statute, but here the statute is documented in active use as a police lever and lethal public violence is patterned with complete impunity — materially worse than 0.25-C's brief-sentences regime.

0.35-A features universal, systematic state exclusion of trans visitors but no imprisonment or lethal outcome; this dossier lacks that universal exposure but shows state-tolerated violence reaching severity 5 with no recourse — higher severity, somewhat lower probability mechanics, netting slightly below 0.35-A.
0.15-C has organised morality sweeps of visitors; here targeting is societal/vigilante with state tolerance rather than state-directed sweeps, and no documented capital pathway — a tier below 0.15.

parsed.synthesis: The combined regime couples an enforced sexuality statute used against gender-nonconforming people, pervasive societal hostility (85-88% disapproval, vigilante and mob violence with impunity), and a hostile or indifferent police response — the tier-2/3 combination of state-tolerated targeting and documented societal hostility with thin recourse. Custody is effectively birth-sex assigned with documented identity-targeted violence. No universal-exposure border or facility rule is documented, and tourist zones are insulated, which tempers everyday probability; but once outed — via any arrest, emergency, or local disclosure — the documented consequence pattern runs from harassment to lethal violence without remedy. This sits at the top of the High Risk band, below any 0.35 anchor's absence of lethal pattern, well above Reduced Risk.
